description: Baseline metrics for regression testing. Generated from data/output/quality-report.json and the frontend dataset. Direction-sensitive: tests fail when a count increases and warn when it decreases; a decrease is frozen here in the next evidence-freeze commit.

known_issues.description: Frozen counts of known data-quality issues. Tests bound the current count against these. Lower is better; when extraction improves, update the value in an evidence-freeze commit.

reviewedUpdates.reason: Removed 95 explicit reference/annotation or discontinuous page locators misclassified as volume extents; lower numberOfPages coverage is a source-correctness improvement. Added source-category language fallbacks and literal redirect-chain resolution. Threshold tolerances are unchanged; unresolved-reference ceiling tightened from 120 to 12.

Eight pages overwritten by the wiki's Redirect fixer account publish their last human revision, so they leave the redirects and join the displayed entries; ten fixer redirects over undelivered revisions are withheld as relations. The redirect map loses the aliases those redirects carried, among them Maria Stuart -> 4113. See-references are read as link targets (label after the pipe dropped, whitespace runs collapsed) and pagelink titles are decoded from UTF-8, which leaves two unresolved references (pages 679 and 7232). The restored Schachnovelle page 279 adds one German entry whose flat translator comes from a later translation block, the known first-match compatibility limit of the flat fields; no extraction rule changed for it.

Stage 03 no longer takes a cross-reference, citation, credit, extent, imprint, header, label, editorial bracket or section heading line as the record title; the source page title is the title then. Those page titles were page-title aliases in the redirect map and are now the entry titles, so the map shrinks from 3532 to 1575 without losing a resolution: every former key that named a page still resolves, the two unresolved See-references (pages 679 and 7232) stay unresolved, and four keys now reach the page that carries the title instead of an entry that used the string as a heading. The semantic title cases on pages 1166 and 1308 are resolved, so the bound falls from 16 to 14.

Stage 03 also takes the page title where the first line is a holdings statement (pages 1768, 2980, 2981, 3657), a postal address (2712), a compiler's note (187, 3262, 3677, 6416), an academic paper statement (3818), a URL (6807), a quoted contribution title followed by its host work (6991), the credit of the author page's own person (6060), a bold label restating a page category or its language (162, 1855), a bold heading directly above a list (513, 1014) or the tail of a broken category link (3923). Those 18 page titles were page-title aliases in the redirect map and are now the entry titles of the same pages, so the map shrinks from 1575 to 1557 without losing a resolution: each removed key is now the unique entry title of the page it pointed to, no key was added and no key changed its target.
